implementation: Readable handwritten C99 descending decimal products and termwise surd scaling; no CPU execution or floating-point substitute

implemented_routines.name: factorial
implemented_routines.scope: Canonical real operands, nonnegative integer gate, descending15-digit products and F3 domain/overflow errors

implemented_routines.name: permutation
implemented_routines.scope: Nonnegative integral n/r below10^10, r<=n, descending n!/(n-r)! product and native intermediate overflow

implemented_routines.name: combination
implemented_routines.scope: Shared n/r gates; symmetric min(r,n-r) factorial divisor, descending numerator order and original finite-decimal division

implemented_routines.name: percent
implemented_routines.scope: Metadata clearing and division by100, exact rational/surd results, termwise reduced surd decimal fallback and F3 error records

implemented_routines.name: shared combinatorial product algorithm
implemented_routines.scope: Operand range checks, saved lower bound selection, factorial loop and permutation/combination result paths

gaps: Expression precedence/dispatch and consumed-pointer behavior are verified separately by parser integration
General surd arithmetic is owned by the numeric foundation; this module preserves term ordering specifically for percent
Malformed BCD, global numeric scratch RAM and reset-to-keypress execution are outside this API
completion: Prepared scalar routine parity; complete firmware equivalence remains unproven
